verdict.rationale: Algolia documents official API clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin and .NET, covered by its SLA. An official agent skill migrates client code across major versions in ten languages. Official InstantSearch UI libraries round this out, and community users praise React InstantSearch's developer experience and the API's stability. Missing for 10: in-depth per-language SDK reference docs in the evidence (the client list is a single line), and independent hands-on corroboration of the backend API clients specifically, rather than only the UI libraries.
